caption: The drawing consists of a top view of an oval-shaped object extending horizontally, with the major axis measuring 65 inches and the minor axis 54 inches, as indicated by red measurement labels and lines. Centrally placed within the oval is a rectangular structure labeled with the word "DRAWER" written twice lengthwise. The rectangle contains four small square sections at each corner, with dashed lines connecting these squares to points near the oval’s edge. The distances between these squares and the oval's edge are marked as "17 3/4" inches, while the distances between the rectangles and the edge are labeled with measurements such as "23", "19", and "23" inches, spanning the length of the major axis. The inner rectangle measures "11 5/8" inches wide and "30" inches long, with two short lines of "2" inches on each side. The drawing uses black ink for objects and outlines, red ink for measurement lines and numbers, and is situated on a beige background with some small brownish stains and marks scattered about. A labeled scale in inches appears at the bottom right alongside the inscription "TOP VIEW." The drawing is enclosed within a double rectangular border. The name "B. Holst-Grubbe" appears at the bottom left corner.
title: Gate-legged Table
